A Company pays regular dividend on quarterly basis and the last

has seen an annual compounded growth of 25% (CAGR) in the last

(D)  The current interest rate on GOI Treasury bond is at 4.5% and the 
beta of the company is 1.3 and a market return of 12.5% 
You are required to CALCULATE the theoretical market price of the 
company’s share for Mr. A’s decision-making using Gordon’s model and 
Walter’s model.
